Container.Name: cloud-billing-exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for Azure/GCP/Hetzner cloud spend. Polls each provider's billing API and exposes current cost by service/project/currency in Prometheus text format. Config is a JSON file (see config.example.json in the repo) plus per-provider credential files, all read-only bind mounts - never baked into the image.
Container.Requires: At least one cloud provider's read-only billing credentials (Azure/GCP/Hetzner). See the repo README for exact scopes - run setup-credentials.sh for a guided setup.

Config.Name: config
Config.Description: Read-only bind mount holding config.json (see config.example.json in the repo) and any provider credential files it references.

Config.Name: CONFIG_PATH
Config.Description: Path to config.json inside the container.
